stem: A fertilizer program raises phosphorus well above the level used in a study without improving yield. What principle should guide the next decision?
choices: Evaluate whether additional supply is beneficial or merely accumulating and interacting with other nutrients rather than assuming more is better
Use EC alone to prove phosphorus sufficiency
rationale: Nutrient-response research shows that higher supply can fail to improve yield and may alter nutrient balance. Plant response and interactions matter more than escalation alone.
